name: houdiniswap
description: Discover, quote, and execute crypto swaps across 14 CEXes and 20+ DEXes via HoudiniSwap, with x402 pay-per-call (USDC on Base or Solana — no signup).

x402_private_key.title: x402 wallet private key (Base)
x402_private_key.description: The API is pay-per-call: every request costs a fraction of a cent in USDC, paid from your wallet. Paste the private key of an EVM wallet funded with USDC on Base — MetaMask's exported key works with or without the 0x prefix. Leave empty to pay on Solana instead (next field). Without either key every request returns 402.

x402_solana_private_key.title: x402 Solana private key (optional)
x402_solana_private_key.description: To pay with USDC on Solana: the base58 private key of a Solana wallet funded with USDC on Solana, as Phantom or Solflare export it. No SOL needed. If both keys are set, Base is tried first unless the next field says solana.

x402_network.title: x402 network to pay on first (optional)
x402_network.description: Only used when both keys are set: base or solana. Leave empty for Base. If a payment is refused on that network (an empty wallet, for example), it is retried on the other one.
